title: Played young Shah Rukh Khan in Baazigar, became a TV superhero, then quit acting to build media tech company: Where is actor Sumeet Pathak now?
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Many may not immediately recognise the name Sumeet Pathak, but they are likely to remember his face. As a child star, he played the younger version of Shah Rukh Khan ’s Ajay Malhotra in the 1993 thriller Baazigar. The role was brief, but his performance stood out enough to earn him a Filmfare Award for Best Child Star and open more doors in the industry. He continued acting through the 1990s, later became a popular television superhero in Hero Bhakti Hi Shakti Hai, and then gradually moved away from acting. Today, Sumeet is working in a very different part of the entertainment business as a media tech entrepreneur.

Adding to this, Remember the child star who played young Shah Rukh Khan in Baazigar? Here’s where Sumeet Pathak is now. From Baazigar to more films Sumeet made his acting debut with Ek Ladka Ek Ladki in 1992. A year later, Baazigar changed the course of his career. As the young Ajay Malhotra, he played the childhood version of Shah Rukh Khan’s character and made an impression on audiences despite having limited screen time.

Meanwhile, The success of the movie was followed by more work. He appeared in Ikke Pe Ikka in 1994 and went on to feature in Rajkumar and Maahir in 1996. At the same time, he was also working on his training. He graduated from the National School of Drama in Delhi and received training in classical dance.

Notably, Like many child actors, Sumeet eventually had to make the difficult move into adult roles. He returned to films in 2002 with Tumko Na Bhool Paayenge, where he played Salman Khan ’s brother. In 2004, he appeared in Taarzan: The Wonder Car with Vatsal Sheth.

As per the latest buzz, His most memorable adult role, however, came on television. From 2005 to 2007, he played Joy Sehgal in Hungama TV’s Hero Bhakti Hi Shakti Hai. The show became particularly popular with younger viewers, with Joy gaining superpowers from Goddess Durga and using them to take on villains.

In further updates, He was also active as a voice artist. He worked on popular animated shows including Oswald, Power Rangers, Richie Rich and Beyblade. He also lent his voice to the Hindi versions of several South Indian films.

On top of that, View this post on Instagram A completely different career Sumeet eventually chose to step away from acting and move into a different part of the entertainment business. He started Gulmohar Media with his wife and business partner Shweta Pathak, and what began with language localisation has since grown into a much larger post-production operation. The company now has studios across six Indian cities, including Mumbai, Bengaluru and Chennai.

Technology has also become a key part of the way the company works. Gulmohar Media uses cloud-based editing and production, making it possible for teams to work remotely instead of depending entirely on traditional studio setups. The company has also expanded its accessibility work, offering sign language services along with audio description.

title: Raj Thackeray to join Pune MPSC protest, day after MP is heckled for defecting
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

Maharashtra Navnirman Sena (MNS) chief Raj Thackeray is scheduled to join protests in Pune, demanding greater transparency in Maharashtra Public Service Commission (MPSC) exams and the resignation of the commission’s chairman, Vivek Bhimnawar, at 4pm on Monday, even as the protesters heckled parliamentarian Omraje Nimbalkar for defecting from Shiv Sena (UBT).

Adding to this, Parliamentarian Omraje Nimbalkar at the protest site. Nimbalkar visited the protest site late on Sunday, the fifth day of the protest. A section of the protesters raised slogans questioning his decision to join the Eknath Shinde-led Shiv Sena in June. Some called him a “traitor”. Nimbalkar defended his decision and insisted that he had not distanced himself from his constituents.

Meanwhile, “I have not gone anywhere. I am right here. I am an elected representative,” he shared. He added that he remained connected with people in his constituency and stood by them during floods, droughts and other crises.
Notably, Nimbalkar shared the lack of power made it difficult for him and his colleagues to carry out work for constituents. He backed the students’ concerns over the MPSC examination system.

As per the latest buzz, Nimbalkar added that an examination is directly linked to a student’s future. He shared irregularities such as question-paper leaks could force the cancellation of examinations, causing severe hardship to aspirants who had prepared for them.
In further updates, Nimbalkar shared the MPSC secretary had been transferred. He added he would meet chief minister Devendra Fadnavis with a delegation of students to press for their demands.

On top of that, Slogan-shouting protesters repeatedly interrupted Nimbalkar’s speech. “I have come here to support you. Have I made a mistake?” asked Nimbalkar amid sloganeering. Agitator Vivekanand Patil appealed to the students to allow him to complete his address. The protesters eventually applauded Nimbalkar after his speech ended.

The agitation continued at three sites. Opposition leaders have visited the Rohit Pawar-led protest at Pune’s SM Joshi Bridge. Ruling Bharatiya Janata Party leaders have visited the group protesting on KBS Road. A third group is holding a separate agitation.

title: Mika Singh asks Diljit Dosanjh why he promoted film with Pakistani actor Hania Aamir but not Border 2: ‘Not even 1%’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Mika Singh has lauded Diljit Dosanjh for taking Punjabi music to a global audience, but he also has one question for the singer-star: why does he not promote his Bollywood films more? In a recent conversation with Times Now, Mika shared he was proud of Diljit’s success but was confused by what he sees as a lack of promotion for some of his Hindi films, including Border 2 .

Adding to this, Mika Singh asks Diljit Dosanjh why he stayed quiet on Border 2 but promoted his movie with Hania Aamir. Mika questions Diljit’s Border 2 promotion Mika was asked if he felt jealous of Diljit’s success. He shared there was no reason for him to feel that way and instead spoke about how proud he was to see another Punjabi singer make it big. Mika dismissed any suggestion of jealousy, saying he was proud of Diljit and his achievements. He credited Diljit with carrying forward the legacy of Daler Mehndi as a turbaned Punjabi singer who has made a strong mark in the music industry.

Meanwhile, Mika then brought up Border 2, which starred Diljit alongside Sunny Deol, Varun Dhawan and Ahan Shetty. Directed by Anurag Singh, the movie is a sequel to the 1997 war drama Border and rolled out in January 2026.

Notably, According to Mika, Diljit could have spoken more about the movie and his experience of working with Sunny Deol. “I could be wrong, but I feel that when Border 2 came out, Diljit paaji did not promote it even one per cent. He didn't even thank Sunny paaji one percent. I have never seen Diljit say, ‘It is a big thing that my movie with Sunny Deol is coming.’ He never spoke about Border 2. When the movie came out, and even afterwards, I didn't see him post about it. And Main Vaapas Aaunga was also rolled out, but he didn't put up any post. He made only one post about his movie in which there was a Pakistani artist,” Mika added.

As per the latest buzz, He went on to question why Diljit would choose not to promote Bollywood projects despite being part of them. “I don't understand this. Why don't you promote Bollywood when you work in Bollywood? Then you say, 'I don't need Bollywood,' but you work in Bollywood. I am saying these things to him as a brother. Border 2 is one of the biggest films for our country. It is a movie about Hindustan. Why don't you post about it? You can check his Instagram and see if there is even one video where he has promoted Border 2,” he added.

In further updates, Diljit did share promotional material for Border 2. He unveiled his first look in December 2025 and featured in the movie’s promotional campaign. He also shared some behind-the-scenes videos from the movie and songs.

On top of that, Mika also spoke about Diljit’s Sardaar Ji 3 , which starred Hania Aamir alongside Diljit and Neeru Bajwa. “The only one he posted was about his movie with the Pakistani heroine ( Hania Aamir ). Neeru Bajwa is also in that movie, but there was no mention of Neeru Bajwa. I feel you should promote everything,” he shared.

Sardaar Ji 3 became controversial in 2025 because Hania was part of the cast. Her involvement came under scrutiny amid tensions between India and Pakistan following the Pahalgam terror attack. The movie did not rollout theatrically in India and instead opened overseas on June 27, 2025.

title: Rakul Preet Singh breaks silence on Income Tax searches at her place, calls reports ‘false, malicious’: The search was not pertaining to me
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Star Rakul Preet Singh has issued a statement regarding reports that the Income Tax Department conducted searches at her addresses over financial irregularities. The star has called the reports ‘malicious and false’, saying she has no Benami property, as claimed in some reports.

Adding to this, Rakul Preet Singh has addressed the IT searches at locations linked to her. Rakul Preet Singh addresses reports of IT searches In a long note Rakul shared on Instagram, the star addressed some of the news reports about the IT searches at her premises and wrote, “It’s heartbreaking to see that there’s a growing trend amongst the self-styled online reporters & some mainstream media journalists to sensationalise the news without verifying facts. Let’s therefore set the record straight once and for all. The search was not pertaining to me.”

Meanwhile, The star added that she has been paying her income tax for years and has no illegal remittance. “Let it be known that I am from the Armed Forces background & had no Godfather in the Industry. I have come up through sheer hard work & as a responsible law-abiding citizen have been paying my due taxes since the age of 20 years. I am not involved in any kind of illegal foreign remittance in personal capacity or on behalf of any Production house. I would also add here that I do not hold any Benami property on behalf of anyone anywhere in the country or abroad. Neither ANYONE has EVER gifted me any property at any time nor do I accept such expensive gifts as a principle,” wrote Rakul.

Notably, Addressing the reports that claimed that Rakul’s premises had been ‘raided’ due to suspicion of illegal foreign remittances for movie production, she added, “I urge all those who published these false, malicious and speculative reports to retract them and clarify the facts. I understand that everyone running a media business, however big, has their own commercial pressures. But it cannot come at the cost of facts. And certainly not at the cost of someone's reputation and livelihood.”
As per the latest buzz, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Rakul Singh (@rakulpreet)

In further updates, Last week, reports shared the Income Tax Department had conducted searches at 12 locations linked to Rakul and her father-in-law, producer Vashu Bhagnani. TV9 reported that the IT Department launched searches at 12 locations on Monday, September 28, over suspected fund irregularities. They were shared to be investigating funds that are allegedly being routed abroad under the guise of financing movie projects. Vashu Bhagnani did not respond to queries about the searches.

On top of that, Abhimanyu Mathur is Deputy Editor, Entertainment at Hindustan Times. With almost 15 years of experience in writing about everything from films and TV shows to cricket matches and elections, he inhales and exhales pop culture and news. Currently, he watches movies and TV shows and talks to celebrities for a living, while occasionally writing about them as well. A journalism graduate of Delhi College of Arts and Commerce, Delhi University, Abhimanyu began his career with Hindustan Times at the age of 20, swapping classrooms for newsrooms at an early age. He began his journey in the early days of digital journalism, later switching to the madness of print journalism. Work has led him to far off places like Japan and Jordan, as well as to the interiors of Haryana and the Indo-Pak border. He dabbled in city reporting in places like Meerut, Gurgaon, and Delhi, covered the Olympics and Cricket World Cups, before finding his calling in entertainment and lifestyle during the pandemic. A Rotten Tomatoes Certified Movie Critic, he is equally at home covering stories on ground as he is interviewing celebrities and studios, and sometimes prefers to shepherd teams in delivering traffic through the day. Even as his role has evolved from reporter to supervisor over the years, his first love remains writing (and of late, talking on camera). title: Delhi Police avoid name tags at Jantar Mantar protests to prevent social media targeting
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

Police deployed at Delhi’s Jantar Mantar for protests against Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar over alleged irregularities in the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of the electoral rolls did not wear name tags as a “deliberate measure” to prevent them from being targeted and identified on social media, officials aware of the matter shared. The measure was adopted because personnel were targeted on social media following the July 20 violence during the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) march, they added.

Adding to this, Members of the All India Students’ Association (AISA) and other student organisations take part in a protest march towards Jantar Mantar amid heavy security deployment on Sunday, October 4, 2026. (Sanchit Khanna/HT photo) The CJP called the march after weeks of protests and a hunger strike at Jantar Mantar. Thousands of demonstrators attempted to march to Parliament demanding the resignation of the then Union education minister Dharmendra Pradhan over examination paper leaks. Police used tear gas and baton-charged to disperse the crowd as protesters attempted to breach multiple layers of barricades. Videos circulating on social media appeared to show several protesters being beaten. The Delhi Police maintained that force became necessary after demonstrators turned violent.

Meanwhile, On day one of the protests against Kumar on Friday, many protesters photographed and filmed police personnel questioning why they were not wearing name tags. In videos circulated on social media, some police personnel shared their tags had fallen off amid the commotion. Others shared they had forgotten to attach them. Some shared they had deliberately removed the tags to prevent them from coming off. Many refused to offer any explanation.
Notably, Officials aware of the matter shared this deliberate measure was part of lessons learnt from the July 20 protests when police personnel were targeted and identified on social media.

As per the latest buzz, Top officers directly involved in crowd management told their seniors in review meetings of crowd handling during the July CJP protests that they and their families were identified and targeted on social media for doing their jobs. “Many officers shared their families were called out by friends or in social circles. Some officers even reported that their families had been deliberately targeted by colleagues at work and through memes on social media,” shared a police officer aware of the deliberations at the review meetings.

In further updates, The officers involved in crowd management were subsequently assured that no action would be taken against anyone for removing name tags if they were performing their duty within the law. “While most IPS [Indian Police Service] officers, who are easily identified by the public, chose to retain their tags at Jantar Mantar this time, many junior personnel were allowed to be on the ground without wearing their tags,” the officer shared. He added that many influencers were posing as media personnel and deliberately targeting police officers.

On top of that, Security forces have had a no-name-tags strategy in Left Wing Extremism-affected areas, the northeast and Jammu and Kashmir. In photographs of anti-insurgency operations, the faces of special forces personnel are blurred.

The removal of tags in Delhi drew criticism as police were accused of excesses while quelling the protests in July. Experts shared there are no written rules mandating whether personnel must wear or remove their name tags. It has long been an operational practice in conflict zones to prevent them from being identified and targeted.

title: Delhi protests LIVE: CJP claims govt planning to arrest Dipke, spokespersons before Oct 10 stir against CEC
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

In this image posted on Oct 2, Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) founder Abhijeet Dipke waves to supporters during a protest by CJP against chief election commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar Protest news LIVE: Security officials and protesters clashed for at least three hours in central Delhi on Sunday, the third consecutive day of protests against Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar over alleged irregularities in the ongoing Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls. More than 120 people were briefly detained as police reiterated that no permission had been granted for the demonstrations. While protesters alleged they had been manhandled, police shared they used minimum force. ...Read More

Adding to this, The protests against CEC Gyanesh Kumar began on October 2, however, the detentions by security forces have triggered calls for extension of the agitation, with the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) announcing a mega demonstration on October 10. Abhijeet Dipke's CJP led protest against CEC Gyanesh Kumar from Mumbai's Shivaji Park on October 2. The protest was also escalated by the accusation of three women journalists against police officers of sexually harassing them during the protest against the Election Commission (EC) at Jantar Mantar on Saturday. Their complaints were forwarded to the crime branch for a detailed probe, the police shared on Sunday. In a post on X, the Delhi Police shared: “On October 3, during the protest in New Delhi area, while being in law and order situation, allegations of sexual harassment were made by three female journalists against police officers. The New Delhi district has received their complaints and the same are transferred to crime branch for fair and impartial enquiry.” Anti-Gyanesh Kumar protest | Key points -Delhi Police deployed around 5,000 personnel, including Rapid Action Force (RAF) and other paramilitary personnel, ahead of protest marches from India Gate to Jantar Mantar on Sunday. Prohibitory orders under Section 163 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) have been in force in the area since July. -A Citizens' March, led by the All India Students' Association (AISA), began at 4pm, followed by a march by the Indian Youth Congress, led by national president Uday Bhanu Chib, along the same route at 5pm. -Around the same time, the Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) and, separately, a group of independent journalists also staged protest marches to India Gate against the CEC. -While the marches began peacefully, tensions escalated as protesters approached Jantar Mantar. Police stopped them at several points, including Ashoka Road at the roundabout near Andhra Bhawan, and later near the Le Méridien and Shangri-La hotels. -Police detained dozens of people, including AISA national president Neha Bora. Bora was picked up in a car, which deputy commissioner of police (New Delhi) Sachin Sharma shared was a "government vehicle with two female staff in the back".

Meanwhile, CJP news LIVE: Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) founder Abhijeet Dipke shared a cryptic X post on Monday saying the local DCP of his hometown has “suddenly gone on leave” and a “new DCP” has come.

Notably, “The local DCP of my hometown has suddenly gone on leave, and a new DCP has been brought in to take charge,” he shared on X amid claims by CJP leadership of being informed by sources that the government is planning to arrest them before October 10.

As per the latest buzz, Delhi protests LIVE: Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) founder Abhijeet Dipke shared on Monday that the chief election commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar is “more valuable to this regime than the citizens of this country.”

In further updates, “Gyanu is more valuable to this regime than the citizens of this country. Because to stay in power, they don't need you or your vote. They just need Gyanu. And that is exactly why Gyanu must go!" Dipke shared on X.

On top of that, His statement came in response to CJP spokespersons' claim that the government is planning to arrest the three - Abhijeet Dipke, Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka - before the October 10 protest against chief election commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.

“If the Govt believes that the threat of UAPA, NSA or years behind bars will scare us into silence, it won’t. We are prepared to face whatever comes our way and, if necessary, spend months or years in jail, but we will not back off from our fight to save democracy,” Dipke shared on X.

title: BJP threatens agitation over Form 7 cases across K’taka
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

The BJP on Sunday threatened a statewide agitation if police take legal action against its workers over bulk filing of Form 7 applications during Karnataka’s Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls, escalating the political fight over alleged attempts to delete voters.

Adding to this, Former chief minister and senior BJP leader B S Yediyurappa issued the warning (PTI) Former chief minister and senior BJP leader B S Yediyurappa issued the warning after a party delegation led by him met Director General and Inspector General of Police M A Saleem and sought protection for workers facing police cases. The delegation included state BJP president B Y Vijayendra, Leader of Opposition R Ashoka, Council Opposition leader Chalavadi Narayanaswamy, MPs, MLAs and MLCs.
Meanwhile, He alleged that the police were acting at the behest of Chief Minister DK Shivakumar and shared officers should act according to law rather than work to please the government.

Notably, The BJP’s intervention came as police registered another case linked to the Form 7 row in Bengaluru. The Vyalikaval police have registered an FIR following a complaint by Congress leader Anoop Iyengar over 778 applications seeking deletion of voters in the Malleswaram Assembly constituency.

As per the latest buzz, G S Vasanthalakshmi, identified in the FIR as a BJP member, has been named accused No. 1. Another person, described as being associated with an RSS wing, has been listed as an unidentified accused. The complaint alleges that the applications sought deletion of voters who had in fact cast their votes, by describing them as having shifted residence or as otherwise ineligible. The 778 applications were spread across eight polling parts.

In further updates, Ashoka defended the submission of Form 7 applications and shared the validity of individual applications should be decided by election authorities. “Submitting Form 7 is not a crime. It is the Election Commission, not the police station, that has to determine the truth and validity of a voter,” he shared.

On top of that, The BJP’s warning follows a direction from Karnataka Chief Electoral Officer V Anbukkumar to Electoral Registration Officers in all 224 Assembly constituencies to act against applicants who knowingly make false statements or declarations in Forms 6, 6A, 7 and 8.

In a circular issued on October 1, Anbukkumar directed EROs to take action under Section 31 of the Representation of the People Act, 1950, after an inquiry under Rule 20 of the Registration of Electors Rules, 1960.

title: Drishyam 3 director Abhishek Pathak's wife Shivaleeka Oberoi tears up seeing thank you note for her in end credits: ‘I believed in you’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Drishyam 3 is on a rampage at the ticket-window. The Ajay Devgn -starrer has managed to cross the ₹ 175 crore rupees mark in 3 days, and is now poised to cross the ₹ 200 crore rupees mark today! The thriller is directed by Abhishek Pathak , who is receiving praise for handling the story with great skill and concluding it well. Now, Abhishek's wife, star Shivaleeka Oberoi has shared a video of her watching the movie in a theatre.

Adding to this, Shivaleeka Oberoi is celebrating the success of Drishyam 3. Shivaleeka gets emotional In the video shared on Instagram, Shivaleeka was emotional seeing that her husband had penned a thank you note for her in the end credits of the movie, crediting her for her support throughout the journey. She shared a heartfelt note in the caption and wrote, “I teared up when I saw this on the big screen. And judging by the messages I’ve been getting, I’m clearly not the only one who thought this was pretty special.”
Meanwhile, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Shivaleeka Oberoi Pathak (@shivaleekaoberoi)

Notably, She added, "When you started this journey, there was so much that life was about to bring our way. There were sacrifices, difficult days, time apart, and so many moments that tested us. But through it all, I believed in you, in your vision and in what you were creating.

As per the latest buzz, Today, watching the world celebrate what you created makes every bit of it feel worth it. And sometimes I look at Aarika and think..how lucky is she going to feel one day knowing her father directed Drishyam. So incredibly proud to be your wife!"

In further updates, Earlier this year in April, Abhishek Pathak and Shivaleeka Oberoi celebrated the arrival of their baby girl. Their post read, “In a moment, our hearts found a whole new meaning! With immense love and gratitude, we welcome our precious baby girl. Blessed parents — Shivaleeka & Abhishek.” The caption added, “Our little Goddess Laxmi has arrived on an auspicious day. A blessing in its purest form.”
On top of that, Abhishek and Shivaleeka got married in an intimate ceremony in Goa in 2023. They met while working on the movie Khuda Haafiz (2020), which was directed by Abhishek.

Drishyam: The Conclusion sees Ajay Devgn reprise his role as Vijay Salgaonkar for one final time. The movie also marks the return of Shriya Saran, Ishita Dutta, Tabu, and Rajat Kapoor. Jaideep Ahlawat and Prakash Raj are the new entrants to the cast.

title: Sanjay Dutt clarifies after backlash over his 'can't feel peace in India' remark, says it was taken out of context: ‘Never my intention to hurt’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Sanjay Dutt appeared on the star Shekhar Suman -hosted talk show, Shekhar Tonite, on the occasion of Gandhi Jayanti. The star shared his opinion about the current state of the country, saying that he doesn't feel "peace" in the nation anymore. His comment courted backlash on social media.

Adding to this, Sanjay Dutt has clarified his remark that was made on Shekhar Suman's show. (File Photo/ PTI) What Sanjay Dutt shared On Sunday evening, the star took to his X account to pen a statement and clarified his comments that were made on the show. It read, "I would like to clarify that it was never my intention to hurt, offend, or disrespect the sentiments of any individual, community, or institution.

Meanwhile, My remarks were made in the context of a scripted conversation intended to be light-hearted and humorous. The spirit behind them was similar to the humour and satire seen in films like Munna Bhai, particularly the concept of 'Gandhigiri,' which was intended to convey a message of love, warmth, togetherness, and goodwill. Unfortunately, my words were interpreted outside of that intended context."

Notably, Sanjay had made the comments with his trademark humour, taking a cue from his character from Munna Bhai MBBS. He spoke about the state of the country and explained why he no longer feels the same sense of peace in India as he once did. He shared, “The people of this country are so lovely. There should be peace here. I can’t feel that peace in our country anymore. We Indians are large-hearted people, and we are hospitable. We have given so much, and we should always remain that way. I pray to Shivji that those days come back soon.”

As per the latest buzz, Sanjay Dutt holds a 10-year UAE Golden Visa, and his family -- wife Maanayata Dutt and twins Shahraan and Iqra -- lives in Dubai. He commutes between Mumbai and Dubai for work. In another segment of the show, Sanjay was asked to imagine himself as the Prime Minister for five minutes and say something to the people of the country. The star then delivered a monologue in Munna Bhai-style.

In further updates, Sanjay pretended to be the country's Prime Minister, and even included a veiled joke at PM Narendra Modi's foreign trips. He shared, “Bole toh itna bada desh hai, itne saare log hain aur ab hum sabki zimmedari apun ke upar. Par aap log ekdum tension nahi lene ka. title: Hanuman Ansh director makes humble request as Kainchi Dham sees massive influx of devotees: ‘Waha ki paristithi pata karke hi jana chahiye’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Hanuman Ansh has become a nationwide sensation. The impact of the biopic drama on the life and legacy of Neem Karoli Baba is such that now it has directly impacted the livelihood of people. Videos on social media over the last few days have claimed that thousands of devotees have arrived at Kainchi Dham to pay a visit after watching the movie. Kainchi Dham is a famous spiritual ashram and Hanuman temple in Uttarakhand, known worldwide for its association with the mystic saint Neem Karoli Baba.

Adding to this, Hanuman Ansh has led to a large influx of tourists at Kainchi Dham. What Hanuman Ansh director shared On Sunday evening, Hanuman Ansh director Dr Vishal Chaturvedi took note of the overcrowding at Kainchi Dham after the rollout of his movie. He made a video on Instagram to share a request with people. He shared, “Kainchi Dham mein bohot bheed hui hai iss waqt aur bohot saare logon ka ye kehna hai ki waha Hanuman Ansh movie dekhne ke baad log waha pohonch gaye hai. Yadi aisa hai toh bhi aur yadi aisa nahi hai toh bhi humein sabhi ko waha ki paristithi pata karke hi waha pe jaana chahiye (Kainchi Dham is overcrowded and people have shared that this is because of the influence of Hanuman Ansh. If that is the case, and if that is not the case, even then, people should visit there only after knowing the present condition).”
Meanwhile, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Dr Vishal Chaturvedi (@filmervishal)

Notably, He went on to add that there are many other shrines to visit too, which can be considered by the devotees. Giving example of Neem Karoli village and Vrindavan, Vishal shared that these places are also important if one is unable to get to Kainchi Dham. “Aap sabhi se anurodh hai ki aise samay main yadi kainchi dham mein bohot bheed hai aur ghanto ki line lagi hai toh ap in sthaano pe bhi ja sakte hai… Mera aapse anurodh hai ki aisi sthiti na ho paaye aap ke ghar mein bachche, mahilayein jo hai woh waha pe suffocate ho rahi hai, woh jam mein phasi hui hai (It is a humble request that during this time if there is overcrowding there then visit other places. Don't be part of a situation where the women and the children feel suffocated and get stuck in traffic jam),” he added.

As per the latest buzz, The rush began ahead of the long weekend, with a government holiday on October 2, followed by Saturday and Sunday, giving travellers three consecutive days off. Mussoorie witnessed a major influx of tourists on Friday, leading to long queues of vehicles along the Mussoorie-Dehradun Road.

In further updates, Thousands of vehicles arrived from Delhi-NCR, Haryana, Uttar Pradesh and Punjab, HT reported earlier. Nainital's Kainchi Dham, the shrine of Baba Neem Karoli, also witnessed a large influx of tourists. The rush was driven by the long weekend and the recent rollout of the movie Hanuman Ansh, visuals shared on social media showed.

title: When Bhagyashree revealed how she made sure that her shaadi ki mehendi did not fade for one year after marriage: ‘Toothpick se khud hi laga deti’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Star Bhagyashree and Himalay Dassani have been married for more than thirty years. In a chat with Hauterrfly from earlier this year in January, Bhagyashree opened up about her marriage and how she had one wish- to keep her mehendi intact. The star then went on to share how she made sure that her shaadi ki mehendi did not fade away, keeping it on her palms even after one year of marriage!

Adding to this, Bhagyashree opened up about her marriage and the desire to keep her mehendi. (Photo:Rajesh Kumar/HT) What Bhagyashree shared During the chat, Bhagyashree shared, “Regarding the wedding, I wasn't as attached to the wedding outfit as I was to having mehendi on my hands. That was the only thing that I told my mother-in-law, ‘Buy the wedding saree as you wish, but I just want mehendi on my hands…’ In fact, for a whole year, I didn't let the mehendi fade.”

Meanwhile, “Woh kam ho jaati toh vaapas main bulaake lagwa leti. Jab mehendi waali nahi thi tab mehendi ki katori leke baith jaati aur toothpick se khud hi mehendi laga deti (If it started to come off, the person would be called. When they were not available, I would sit with the bowl and apply it using a toothpick)!” she added with a smile.

Notably, Maine Pyaar Kiya star had also opened up that her husband never really proposed to her. In a surprise move last year, Himalay went down on his knees and popped the question. The star took to her social media and shared about the romantic proposal. She wrote, "Secret let out...No matter what everyone feels about Himalayji being a romantic husband.. he wasn't so earlier and I kept telling him that he never really had proposed to me. So here I was, midst of a photoshoot & to my surprise he just interrupted us with this song. (Diljit would have cried to hear this version tho). But yay ! Hubby decided to finally to go on his knees. Sharing some candid pics that my photographer @prashantsamtani clicked." She used the song Kabhi Usey Noor Noor Kehta Hoon with the pictures.

As per the latest buzz, Star Bhagyashree married Himalay Dassani right after her debut movie Maine Pyar Kiya became a massive hit in 1989. The couple have two children, a son and a daughter. Their son Abhimanyu Dassani made his Bollywood debut in 2019 with Mard Ko Dard Nahi Hota and won the Filmfare Award for Best Male Debut for his performance. Their daughter, Avantika Dassani, debuted with the web series Mithya in 2022. The psychological series also starred Huma Qureshi, Parambrata Chatterjee, Rajit Kapur and Samir Soni in pivotal roles.

title: This Bollywood icon cancelled her grand wedding to billionaire, uninvited 2,000 guests, only to marry him at home
body: Here's the latest relationship update doing the rounds:

Despite being one of the biggest actors of the 1990s, Juhi Chawla has largely kept her personal life away from the limelight. While followers have always been curious about her marriage to billionaire industrialist and Mehta Group chairman Jay Mehta , the star has rarely spoken about her relationship or married life. However, on a few occasions, Juhi has opened up about her wedding and shared some interesting anecdotes about her life with Jay.

Adding to this, Juhi Chawla and Jay Mehta tied the knot in 1995. When Juhi Chawla doubted her marriage would end her career As per reports, Juhi and Jay were introduced by filmmaker Rakesh Roshan, and they eventually fell in love and tied the knot. In 2024, at an event hosted by the Gujarat Chamber of Commerce & Industry, Juhi had opened up about her wedding and opened up that she was initially supposed to have a grand ceremony with around 2,000 guests. However, having lost her mother a year earlier, the star admitted that she was going through emotional turmoil and wanted to cancel the big-fat wedding.

Meanwhile, During the interaction, Juhi also admitted that she was worried that getting married would mark the end of her career. Amid all these emotions, the idea of a big wedding became overwhelming for her. She shared, “I was shooting for some of the really big films of my career, and I was supposed to get married. My mother had just passed a year ago. When the marriage date was coming close, I was thinking my mother is gone, whom I loved the most, and now my career will also go away. I didn’t know how to be happy about it. So, I broke down one day, and I told my mother-in-law.”
Notably, As per a report in the Times Of India, The Mehta Group business empire that he chairs is valued at over ₹ 17,500 crore rupees ($2.1 billion).

As per the latest buzz, While it may have been difficult for many families to accept, Jay Mehta’s mother and Juhi’s mother-in-law prioritised her emotions over the elaborate wedding plans. Juhi shared that despite invitations having been sent out to around 2,000 guests, the wedding was called off in its original form and the couple instead got married at home in a quiet ceremony attended only by family and close friends.

In further updates, Sharing the same, she shared, “My mother-in-law shared, ‘It’s okay.’ Can you imagine your mother-in-law doing it for you? Invitations had gone out to maybe 2000 people. She shared, 'Abhi nahi horahi hai (It's not happening now)'. She convinced the family to not have the big wedding, and I got married, but it was at home with just the family and closest friends. So with just 80-90-100 people, the wedding was done. Imagine your mother-in-law cancelling those invitations which had gone out all over the world.”
On top of that, The couple got married in 1995. They became parents to two children, daughter Jhanvi and son Arjun.
Jay Mehta is a romantic at heart and Juhi once spoke about his grand romantic gestures during their courtship that proved the same.

title: When Aishwarya Rai reacted to her and Abhishek Bachchan being compared to Brad Pitt and Angelina Jolie: ‘Turn this around’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Bollywood A-list couple Aishwarya Rai and Abhishek Bachchan have been married for almost two decades and remain one of the most iconic couples in the Hindi movie industry. Of late, a clip from Aishwarya’s old BBC interview from 2010, just three years after her marriage to Abhishek, has been doing the rounds on social media. In the interview, the couple was referred to as the ‘Brad Pitt and Angelina Jolie of India’. However, it was Aishwarya’s witty response that has her followers in awe.

Adding to this, Aishwarya Rai Bachchan and Abhishek Bachchan have been married for 19 years. When Aishwarya reacted to being called Brad Pitt and Angelina Jolie of India During the interaction, Aishwarya and Abhishek were called the ‘Brad Pitt and Angelina Jolie of India’. Aishwarya, in her trademark charm and confidence, turned the comparison around and shared, “What if we turn this around and call them Aishwarya and Abhishek of America.”

Meanwhile, During the same interview, Aishwarya also spoke about living with her in-laws, Amitabh Bachchan and Jaya Bachchan, after her marriage to Abhishek. Explaining to the English journalist why living with family is considered a normal part of Indian culture, she shared, "Before marriage, I was asked whether I live with my parents and people for some reason would be so intrigued and fascinated by this whole idea, which to us as Indians is normal. We live with our families. We are very family-oriented culture. I have lived with my parents right up to the point I got married. And as Indians mostly when a girl does get married, she goes and stays with her husband, who also stays with his family, largely. I mean, I’m not saying that in the urban culture, people are not living independently of their parents, but, largely, as a culture, this is the set up."

Notably, Aishwarya and Abhishek’s love story began with friendship. The two first worked together in Dhai Akshar Prem Ke in 2000 and later reunited for Kuch Naa Kaho. Their friendship grew over the years before they eventually started dating.

As per the latest buzz, The two grew closer while working together on Umrao Jaan in 2006, and their relationship as per reports blossomed further during the making of Mani Ratnam’s Guru. After the movie’s premiere in New York, Abhishek proposed to Aishwarya on the balcony of his hotel.

In further updates, Aishwarya shared yes, and the couple got married on April 20, 2007, in a private ceremony at the Bachchan family home in Mumbai. They welcomed their daughter, Aaradhya, in November 2011.

On top of that, Vibha Maru is an Assistant Editor with Hindustan Times Entertainment, based in Delhi. She began her career covering Delhi's cultural scene, food, nightlife, concerts, and city life at The Times of India, before moving into full-time entertainment journalism with India Today. At India Today, Vibha interviewed some of the biggest names in Bollywood and television while carving a niche for herself through movie reviews, opinion pieces, nostalgic features, star interviews, and trend-driven stories. She later brought her storytelling and editorial expertise to The Indian Express, where she continued to deepen her understanding of cinema through long-form entertainment explainers, retrospectives and feature writing. Now, as Assistant Editor at Hindustan Times Entertainment, Vibha continues to chronicle the world of movies and pop culture. title: Hanuman Ansh's Parvati song-fame Iranian actor Agni Agyari: I have a past life connection with India, dil se main Indian hoon!
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Iranian star Agni Agyari is relishing the spotlight on her following the unprecedented success of the music video of Parvati, a bhajan from the movie Hanuman Ansh voiced by Sadhu Tiwari, climbed to No. 1 on YouTube Music’s weekly songs chart in India and No. 2 globally. She says there is some divine connection between her and India that’s showering so much love on her.

Adding to this, Star-musician Agni Agyari and a still from the song Parvati from movie Hanuman Ansh (Photo: Instagram) Agni was not the part of the smash hit movie and featured in the musical video that had singer-writer-composer Sadhu Tiwari performing while she played musical instruments.

Meanwhile, “I can only say that this is bhagwan ka ashirwad and I’m a blessed child. I am not in the movie but just a part of the widely shared Parvati video song which I got as I could play musical instruments like hand pan and kahoon (clapbox). They wanted a musician more than an star and my musical training came handy. I even wore my own sari! And, it’s globally trending with people showing so much love for me. People are now noticing my previous work and dots are connecting which is a big thing for me,” she says thanking director Dr Vishal Chaturvedi and singer-composer Rishi Pathak for giving her the chance.
Notably, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Agni Agyari (@agniagyari)

As per the latest buzz, “I don’t know what connection is it but I believe kuch to hai jo mujhe India se jodta hai…maybe past life connection? I was born and raised in Tehran, Iran in Zoroastrian faith, but I was always fascinated by Indian movies. One bhajan that I got hooked on as a child was Om Jai Jagdish Hare . I wrote that in Persian and used to sing in front of Saraswati Maa’s pix that was gifted by my mummy’s student. Dil se mein Indian hi hoon!” says Agni.
In further updates, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Agni Agyari (@agniagyari)

On top of that, In India since the last four years, she has worked with commercials with actors Shah Rukh Khan , Kareena Kapoor Khan and Yami Gautam besides working in TV series Bade Acche Lagte Hain-3 and Showtime .

Agni says she strategically planned her path but what’s happening is divine. “For two years I did not do any project where I needed to speak as I wanted to learn to speak Hindi as I didn’t want to do foreign national roles. And, now results are showing I did Sanjay Leela Bhansali’s production Do Deewane Seher Mein earlier this year and the of late rolled out movie Love Lottery directed Arvind Pandey sir.”

title: Drishyam 3 box office collection day 3 (updated live): Ajay Devgn film continues rampage, crosses ₹150 crore to beat Awarapan 2, The RajaSaab lifetime
body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:

Drishyam 3 ticket-window earnings day 3: Ajay Devgn’s Drishyam The Conclusion is continuing its rampage at the domestic ticket-window for the third day in a row. The crime thriller, which marks the culmination of the Drishyam saga, has crossed the ₹ 150 crore rupees mark and is poised to storm past the ₹ 200 crore rupees mark soon.

Adding to this, Drishyam 3 ticket-window earnings day 3: Jaideep Ahlawat plays Rajveer Singh Tomar, an IPS officer, in Drishyam The Conclusion. Drishyam 3 ticket-window update The advance bookings for Drishyam The Conclusion were enough indication that the movie was poised for a massive opening weekend. The movie registered the fourth-highest advance-booking collection for an opening day by a Hindi movie. The overall advance booking for the opening weekend exceeded ₹ 50 crore rupees even before rollout. Drishyam 3 sold 13 lakh tickets before it rolled out. All of this culminated in a historic opening weekend.

Meanwhile, On rollout day, Drishyam The Conclusion collected a massive ₹ 62 crore rupees net in India, the fourth-biggest opening by a Hindi movie ever. On Saturday, the movie dipped a bit, returning figures of ₹ 53.50 crore rupees. However, it was still enough to take the movie past ₹ 100 crore rupees. On Sunday, the movie saw its earnings accelerate. By 5 PM , Drishyam The Conclusion had crossed the ₹ 150 crore rupees mark, settling in at ₹ 154 crore rupees net.

Notably, On Sunday, Drishyam 3’s morning shows saw around 42% occupancy across India, with some tier-2 and tier-3 centres reporting even higher occupancy. This is already among the biggest opening weekends by a Hindi movie in history.

As per the latest buzz, Drishyam The Conclusion’s record-breaking opening weekend has allowed it to surpass the lifetime collections of several big films from recent times. It had already beaten Salman Khan ’s Sikandar ( ₹ 107 crore rupees) on Saturday. By Sunday afternoon, it had surpassed Prabhas’ The RajaSaab ( ₹ 138 crore rupees), Emraan Hashmi’s Awarapan 2 ( ₹ 150 crore rupees), and Ajay’s own movie, Shaitaan ( ₹ 144 crore rupees).

In further updates, Drishyam The Conclusion is on course to register one of the biggest opening weekends for a Hindi movie at the domestic market. The overall record - Dhurandhar 2’s massive ₹ 443 crore rupees start - is well beyond its reach, as are the marks set by Shah Rukh Khan’s Jawan ( ₹ 286 crore rupees) and Pathaan ( ₹ 280 crore rupees). But a strong day has helped it break into the top 10, potentially overtaking War ( ₹ 166 crore rupees) and Sultan ( ₹ 180 crore rupees). However, surpassing Animal ( ₹ 202 crore rupees) and Stree 2 ( ₹ 204 crore rupees) may just be out of its grasp.

On top of that, The third part of the franchise brings back Ajay Devgn ’s Vijay Salgaonkar, along with Tabu, Shriya Saran, Rajat Kapoor, Ishita Dutta, Mrunal Jadhav, and Kamlesh Sawant. The new entrants in the cast are Jaideep Ahlawat and Prakash Raj. Written and directed by Abhishek Pathak, the movie rolled out in theatres on October 2.

title: Soha Ali Khan on World animal day: The first connection I had with an animal was with a little mouse that lived in my bedroom
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

On World animal day, in a chat with us Soha Ali Khan says she has always had an instinctive connection with animals. She says, "As a child I grew up spending a lot of time in Bhopal and Pataudi surrounded by farm animals . At our home in Delhi we were surrounded by a lot of guests like lizards and mice. The first connection I had with an animal was with a little mouse that lived in my bedroom. City children today would be freaked out but I was comfortable sharing my room with a little mouse." She recalls spending a lot of time in the wild in jungles with her family. "I understood animals weren't there to play with, they just existed and we didn't need to interact excessively with them. I was curious but respected that there could be distance between us and animals," says Soha.

Adding to this, Soha with Oreo The star recalls her father (Tiger Pataudi) telling her it's important for every child to grow up with a pet. "That's why we always had dogs growing up. It teaches you to deal with grief because you will inevitably outlive your pet and have to deal with that grief as a child . That is an important life lesson. When Masti (Kunal Kemmu's dog) passed away it was difficult for Kunal and me but also for Inaaya, it was the first time she had encountered loss and the finality of death." Kunal went on to get a tattoo of Masti. She says, "I knew Kunal was going to get Masti tattooed on his body and it was touching because she was his baby and a tattoo is permanent. It's beautiful to carry a memory of an animal on your body, he had an incredibly deep bond with Masti, so it was only right she should be with him forever."

Meanwhile, Currently pet parent to her dog Oreo Soha says animals pick up on tone, body language, energy or any change in routine. She says, "If Kunal and I start to have an argument or opposing point of view, Oreo picks up on that and starts barking. He jumps on us and tries to get us to bring down our tone. Oreo is empathetic, he comes to whoever is feeling low and licks your ear or put his head on you. He's like a therapy dog."

Notably, She says yhe animal She is fascinated by is the elephant. "They are massive but also intelligent. I'm intrigued by how they form bonds, I would love to observe them in their natural environment without being intrusive. I've seen mothers protecting their babies as well as how they flap their ears when angry, during a trip to South Africa, it's terrifying."

As per the latest buzz, Speaking about how Inaaya looks after Oreo she says, “She makes sure she's not feeding him too many treats and he's not having the food we have. When her friends come home she instructs them on how to look after him. She does not getting carried away and remembers he's not a soft toy and that there is a certain way you have to carry him, their spine is different unlike ours.”

title: From Madgaon Express to Zindagi Na Milegi Dobara: 5 best buddy comedies to watch on OTT with your friends
body: Here's the latest on what's streaming and coming up:

There is something special about movies that put friendship at the centre of the story. From chaotic road trips and disastrous holidays to college memories and friendships that survive the toughest phases of life, buddy comedies are the perfect fix for the end of a bad day.

Adding to this, Madgaon Express and Zindagi Na Milegi Dobara explore old friendship and the chaos that comes with it. If you’re looking for a fun movie to watch with your friends or simply want to relive some old memories, here are five buddy comedies you can watch on OTT.

Meanwhile, Not many Bollywood films have captured the emotional complexity and chaos of male friendship quite like Zindagi Na Milegi Dobara . The 2011 movie follows three childhood friends -- Arjun ( Hrithik Roshan ), Kabir (Abhay Deol) and Imran (Farhan Akhtar) -- who head to Europe for a bachelor trip that becomes a journey of self-discovery and, in many ways, a rejuvenation of their school friendship. From skydiving and deep-sea diving to the iconic La Tomatina sequence, the movie sees the three friends navigate the roads of Europe while also learning a little more about each other -- and themselves.

Notably, Packed with confrontation, hilarious banter, adventure and moments of introspection, the movie explores how friendships survive for years when people learn to accept, forgive and evolve with each other. Directed by Zoya Akhtar, you can watch this movie on Netflix.

As per the latest buzz, While in ZNMD, the three good-looking leads travel across Europe, Kunal Kemmu’s directorial debut Madgaon Express hits closer to home. It follows three friends, played by Divyenndu, Pratik Gandhi and Avinash Tiwary, who have been planning a trip to Goa since school, only to finally fulfil their wish after becoming full-grown adults.

In further updates, However, this isn’t a journey of self-discovery and contemplation. Their long-awaited holiday takes a hilariously wrong turn when they get entangled with a local drug mafia. What starts as a much-awaited getaway soon lands them in a series of scary yet ridiculously funny situations involving gangsters, mistaken identities and complete chaos. A full-blown comedy of errors, Madgaon Express is one of the best buddy comedies of recent times. You can watch it on Amazon Prime Video and laugh till your stomach hurts.

On top of that, Nitesh Tiwari might be busy with his highly anticipated movie Ramayana now, but in 2019, he gave us one of the most memorable buddy comedies of recent times — Chhichhore. The movie takes viewers back to the carefree days of college life while exploring the friendships that stay with us long after graduation. It stars Sushant Singh Rajput, Varun Sharma, Shraddha Kapoor, Tahir Raj Bhasin and others.

Sushant and Varun’s fun banter in the movie will remind you of that one friend you can call anytime, even if you haven’t spoken in years. At its heart, Chhichhore is about a group of college friends whose lives are shaped by the years they spend together. Moving between their college days and adulthood, the movie revisits old friendships, rivalries and the bonds that somehow survive the distance and passage of time. You can watch this movie on JioHotstar.

title: Pawar urges Maharashtra govt to hold talks with protesting MPSC aspirants
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

Pune, NCP chief Sharad Pawar on Sunday urged the Maharashtra government to immediately engage in dialogue with protesting MPSC aspirants to resolve their grievances over examination transparency and administrative reforms.

Adding to this, Pawar urges Maharashtra govt to hold talks with protesting MPSC aspirants In conversation with reporters, Pawar noted unease among students in Pune and Mumbai and emphasised that meaningful communication between state leadership and student bodies is essential to end the deadlock.

Meanwhile, MPSC aspirants have been protesting over demands including the removal of the MPSC chairman and transparency in the conduct of examinations.. The Maharashtra Public Service Commission postponed the State Services Main Examination 2026, scheduled for October 3.

Notably, It had earlier shared that a high-level committee reviewing the existing exam systems has held extensive discussions with numerous candidates and other stakeholders and has also studied best practices.

As per the latest buzz, "There is a clear sense of unease among students in Pune, Mumbai and some other parts of the state. They have taken up a struggle and launched an agitation over their demands. Keeping this unrest in mind, the state government and concerned institutions need to take note of the situation and take steps to find a way forward," Pawar shared.
In further updates, He shared that some student representatives had met him and explained their concerns and demands, and shared that all steps should be taken with their consent.

On top of that, "On one side there is the chief minister and his colleagues, and on the other are the student representatives. If there is no dialogue between them, the problem will not be solved. If the issue is to be resolved, there has to be meaningful communication," he shared.

The veteran leader shared he had spoken to Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis over the phone regarding the agitation, and urged him to immediately look into the issue once he returns to Mumbai from Nagpur and hold a dialogue with the students.

In a post on X on Saturday, the AISA wrote, “Today, Delhi Police manhandled, assaulted & groped female students & journalists. Why? Not for demanding CEC Gyanesh Kumar’s removal. Just because Delhi Police treat women as objects to assault with impunity.” Youth Congress march at 5 pm The protest march by Indian Youth Congress (IYC) is scheduled for 5 pm, it revealed on X, calling for the resignation of CEC Gyanesh Kumar. “Delhi, we have plans tonight. No cafes. No clubs. Bas mashaal, placards aur thode uncomfortable sawaal,” the post read. Women journalists accuse Delhi Police of sexual harassment Three women journalists have accused senior Delhi Police officers of sexual harassment during Saturday's protest against the Election Commission (EC) at Jantar Mantar. The police shared on Sunday that their complaints had been forwarded to the Crime Branch for a detailed investigation. In a post on X, the Delhi Police shared: “On October 3, during the protest in New Delhi area, while being in law and order situation, allegations of sexual harassment were made by three female journalists against police officers. The New Delhi district has received their complaints and the same are transferred to crime branch for fair and impartial enquiry.” The journalists have alleged that police officers deployed at the protest site touched them inappropriately while they were reporting on the demonstrations. On Saturday evening, several independent journalists and social media influencers held a protest outside Parliament Street police station, demanding that FIRs be registered against the accused officers, including an assistant commissioner of police (ACP). Police step up security The police shared permission had not been granted for either of the marches from India Gate to Jantar Mantar. However, it is expecting a large turnout as the protests enter their third consecutive day. The police shared PCR vans and other police vehicles would be stationed along all roads leading to Jantar Mantar. CCTV cameras will be monitored from the DCP (New Delhi) office. Drones may also be deployed to monitor the crowd and review security arrangements if the law-and-order situation demands it. Police personnel have been equipped with anti-riot gear, and the ministry of home affairs has been briefed on the security measures, officials shared. Why CEC Gyanesh Kumar is under fire CEC Gyanesh Kumar is at the centre of a row surrounding the Election Commission following an investigative report by The Indian Express that claimed that Election Commissioners Sukhbir Singh Sandhu and Vivek Joshi had raised objections at least 14 times over 10 months regarding decisions and procedures related to the SIR exercise. Notably, Multi-layered barricading has been put in place on routes leading to Jantar Mantar, with police blocking access from Tolstoy Marg, Janpath Road, Sansad Marg and the Kerala Bhawan side. Barricades have also been installed near Ashoka Road and C-Hexagon.

As per the latest buzz, A police officer shared district forces, reserve personnel, RAF and other paramilitary forces have been deployed from Parliament Street police station to Jantar Mantar on both sides. “Though permission has not been granted, we are expecting huge numbers,” the officer shared, seeking anonymity.

In further updates, PCR vans and police vehicles will be deployed on all routes leading to Jantar Mantar, while CCTV cameras will be monitored directly from the DCP (New Delhi) office, the police shared. Drones will also be used to monitor the crowd and assess security arrangements if the law-and-order situation becomes a concern.
On top of that, Police shared anti-riot gear has been provided to personnel and the Ministry of Home Affairs has been informed about the security arrangements.

The city police have registered three FIRs against protesters in connection with the recent demonstrations at and around Jantar Mantar. Three complaints alleging sexual harassment of women protesters and journalists by police personnel have been received by the police and sent to the Crime Branch for investigation.

body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

State leaders of the Congress and the Sharad Pawar-led NCP (SP) also joined the march, which started from Metro Cinema and covered a short distance to the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) headquarters in south Mumbai. ...Read More

Adding to this, The march, dubbed the ‘Virat Garjana Morcha’ (Grand Roar March), saw participants demand the removal or resignation of the CEC over alleged irregularities in the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls. Organisers prohibited party flags at the protest. Participants and supporters were allowed to carry only the national tricolour. The agitation against CEC has emerged as a key national campaign against alleged irregularities in the revision of electoral rolls. On Friday, a large number of people gathered at Mumbai's Shivaji Park to demand Kumar's resignation at a rally organised by Abhijit Dipke-led Cockroach Janta Party (CJP). This marks the third joint appearance by the Thackeray cousins, who were rivals until of late, since they decided to put their differences aside. Their first joint move was to celebrate the withdrawal of a government resolution seeking to make Hindi compulsory in Maharashtra's schools. They later came together to protest the NEET paper leak. Now, they have joined hands to demand the CEC's removal. Delhi to also see protests over ECI today The Delhi Police has deployed around 5,000 personnel in New Delhi ahead of two protest marches scheduled to take place from India Gate to Jantar Mantar on Sunday. The police have refused permission for both marches and are preparing for a large turnout as the protests in the national capital enter their third consecutive day. Two marches have been planned for Sunday. A Citizens’ March is scheduled to begin at 3 pm, followed by an Indian Youth Congress march along the same route at 5 pm. At least 1,000 protesters were detained on Friday as they attempted to reach Jantar Mantar during demonstrations against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over alleged irregularities in the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls. title: Drishyam 3 worldwide box office collection: Ajay Devgn film races to ₹177 crore; beats part 1's lifetime haul in just 2 days
body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:

Drishyam 3 worldwide ticket-window earnings day 2: After a record-breaking start on Friday, Ajay Devgn ’s Drishyam: The Conclusion slowed down a bit on Saturday, but still had enough momentum to cross the ₹ 150 crore rupees mark in just two days. The movie has now entered the top 10 highest-grossing Hindi films of the year and is set to climb the list very quickly.

Adding to this, Drishyam 3 worldwide ticket-window earnings day 2: Ajay Devgn stars in this thriller. Drishyam 3 ticket-window update The advance bookings for Drishyam The Conclusion were proof of how well it was slated to perform. The movie registered the fourth-highest advance-booking collection for an opening day by a Hindi movie. The overall advance booking for the movie by rollout day exceeded ₹ 50 crore rupees. This converted into a strong opening day, helping the movie amass ₹ 93 crore rupees worldwide on Friday.

Meanwhile, The trend of solid collections continued on Saturday as well. The Abhishek Pathak directorial collected ₹ 53.50 crore rupees net on Saturday in addition to the ₹ 62 crore rupees it collected on Friday. This takes the Drishyam The Conclusion’s domestic earnings to ₹ 115.50 crore rupees net ( ₹ 138.60 crore rupees gross) after two days. The movie is on course for one of the biggest opening weekends for a Hindi movie, rivalling Stree 2 and Animal.

Notably, Overseas, Drishyam 3 did not have the same kind of craze and fervour, but it still performed better than most of Ajay Devgn's films. According to trade sources, Drishyam The Conclusion showed an improvement overseas on Saturday. So far, it has collected a neat $4 million in international territories. This takes its worldwide gross to ₹ 177 crore rupees.

As per the latest buzz, Drishyam 3’s mind-blowing start has put many pan-India films in the shade. It has also surpassed the lifetime collections of many recent big-budget films, including Salman Khan’s Sikandar, which collected ₹ 176 crore rupees last year. But most impressive has been Drishyam The Conclusion’s performance relative to the first two parts. On Saturday morning, the movie surpassed the lifetime collection of Drishyam. The 2015 movie collected ₹ 107 crore rupees at the ticket-window.

In further updates, The third part of the franchise brings back Ajay Devgn’s Vijay Salgaonkar, along with Tabu, Shriya Saran, Rajat Kapoor, Ishita Dutta, Mrunal Jadhav, and Kamlesh Sawant. Saurabh Shukla also reprises his role from part 2 in a cameo. The new entrants in the cast are Jaideep Ahlawat and Prakash Raj. Written and directed by Abhishek Pathak, the movie rolled out in theatres on October 2, a date quite significant for the franchise.

title: ‘Rajpal Yadav wasn't asked to leave Mushtaq Khan's funeral’: Social media creator Nazma Shaikh sets the record straight on viral video
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

The woman whose videos showed Rajpal Yadav allegedly being asked to leave fellow star Mushtaq Khan 's funeral has now issued a clarification. Social media creator Nazma Shaikh has broken her silence on the row after videos surfaced online alleging that he was asked to leave during the prayer meet of star Mushtaq Khan.

Adding to this, Rajpal Yadav at Mushtaq Khan's prayer meet. Nazma Shaikh addresses the incident Addressing the widely shared videos and claims circulating online, Nazma shared her anger was directed at people taking pictures during the funeral and not at Rajpal Yadav.

Meanwhile, On Friday, Nazma shared a video on her social media account, explaining what happened during the prayer meet and burial. She shared several reports had created “misconceptions” about the incident and urged people to understand the complete context before drawing conclusions.

Notably, In her video, she shared, “The reality is that Rajpal bhaiya was very close to Mushtaq Khan. He considered him like an elder brother, and they shared a very close bond. Two hours before Mushtaq Khan’s death, Rajpal Bhaiya was with him. He was also present on the day Mushtaq Khan was taken to the graveyard. He was present at the prayer meet as well….I’m sharing these facts so that people can understand the reality and not be misled by misconceptions.”
As per the latest buzz, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Nazma Shaikh ( Fame Media ) (@nazma9846)

In further updates, The video appeared to show Nazma speaking with Rajpal Yadav and asking him to leave the premises. But in the new video, Nazma explained that her reaction was towards people who were taking pictures during the funeral without considering the situation.

On top of that, She shared, “My anger was directed towards those people who were there only to click pictures, without understanding the kind of atmosphere they were in. I want to make it very clear that my anger was not directed at Rajpal Bhaiya. It was directed at those who were taking pictures at a time and place where people were there to mourn and pay their respects.”
“I urge my friends in the media not to run misleading narratives. Please understand the complete context and publish the whole truth,” she added.

title: Dipke, Das, CJP leaders and 400+ supporters booked after Shivaji Park protest in Mumbai
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

The Shivaji Park police have registered a case against Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) leaders Abhijeet Dipke, Saurabh Das, Pranav Ahire, Ashutosh Ranka, Ajinkya Shinde, Afreen Nawaz, Saumya Korde, Ankit Bharadwaj, Vijay Malangi and Yogesh Ingle, along with more than 400 unidentified supporters, for allegedly holding an unlawful assembly and raising slogans during the party’s protest at Shivaji Park on Friday.

Adding to this, Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) founder Abhijeet Dipke, singer and songwriter Vishal Dadlani and others during a protest by CJP against Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar, demanding his resignation, at Shivaji Park, in Mumbai (PTI) According to the police, around 400-500 protesters gathered near Gate No. 6 of the Shivaji Park grounds, in front of the Meenatai Thackeray Memorial, from around 2pm to 7pm.

Meanwhile, The police alleged that the gathering obstructed traffic and that loudspeakers were used without the required permission. The case has been registered under Sections 189 (unlawful assembly) and 223 (disobedience to a public servant’s lawful order) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), besides Sections 37 and 135 of the Maharashtra Police Act.

Notably, The case follows the CJP’s decision to proceed with its ‘Jail Bharo Andolan��� at Shivaji Park despite the Mumbai Police denying permission for the gathering. The police had advised the organisers to seek an alternative venue, citing restrictions on the use of the historic ground under a 2013 Bombay High Court order and a subsequent Maharashtra government order. The police also shared the organisers had not submitted the requisite BMC permission for using the ground.

As per the latest buzz, In its communication to CJP, the police cited Shivaji Park’s residential surroundings and silence-zone status, warning that the protest could lead to noise pollution and traffic congestion and potentially affect access to hospitals in the vicinity. The organisers, however, went ahead with the agitation after CJP founder Dipke opened up that the denial of permission would lead to a ‘Jail Bharo Andolan’. Dipke had also posted on X that the Mumbai Police had denied permission for the October 2 protest, calling the decision an attempt to suppress citizens’ voices.

In further updates, The protest was organised to demand the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar amid allegations concerning the Election Commission’s handling of the Special Intensive Revision (SIR ) of electoral rolls. CJP leaders have also demanded a criminal case against Kumar and a rollback of the SIR exercise. The Election Commission has defended the revision process.

On top of that, The gathering drew thousands of people, predominantly young protesters, as well as public figures including actors Shabana Azmi and Naseeruddin Shah, singer Vishal Dadlani and filmmaker Vishal Bhardwaj. Tushar Gandhi, Mahatma Gandhi’s great-grandson, was also present. The police deployed around 300 personnel and shared the situation remained peaceful, with roads leading to Shivaji Park blocked during the protest and cleared afterwards.

Addressing the gathering, Dipke shared the protest was the beginning of a wider agitation and warned of a prolonged campaign if Kumar did not resign. He shared the movement would continue for three months and referred to a planned “Jantar Mantar 2.0”.

title: Disha Salian death case: Advocate submits new piece of evidence to CBI, seeks custodial interrogation of accused: ‘We intend to file a fresh petition’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Advocate Nilesh Ojha, in connection with the death case of Disha Salian , on Saturday, shared that points raised by him earlier were being substantiated as more evidence emerged. In a new update from news agency ANI, Ojha claimed that a report submitted to the Home Ministry regarding the reinstatement of former police officer Sachin Vaze had raised fresh questions in the case.

Adding to this, Disha Salian, former star manager, has made headlines due to her father accusing Shiv Sena (UBT)'s Aaditya Thackeray in the case of her death (@Rishabhsingh4747/Instagram) What Advocate Ojha shared Advocate Ojha, representing Satish Salian in the case, shared, "Regarding this case, all the points we raised are being substantiated as more evidence comes to light. From our allegations of a false cover-up and the state of Disha's body to the High Court order, the SIT report, and the records currently with the CBI, everything we claimed is being proven true."

Meanwhile, Ojha told ANI that he had obtained a new piece of evidence in the form of a report submitted to the Home Ministry. "We have now obtained a new piece of evidence: a report submitted to the Home Ministry. It clearly states that on June 5, 2020, Sachin Vaze was urgently reinstated into service and assigned to the Crime Intelligence Unit (CIU)," he shared.

Notably, He further alleged that Vaze's appointment to the CIU violated the applicable regulations. Ojha further shared, "The rules required an officer of the rank of Police Inspector (PI) for the CIU, but Sachin Vaze did not meet this criterion; he was of a lower rank, yet he was appointed there in violation of the regulations."

As per the latest buzz, "This evidence suggests that Vaze was urgently reinstated to execute a conspiracy that included the murder of Disha and its subsequent cover-up, as well as to facilitate extortion, the drug trade, and other illicit activities," he shared. Ojha shared that all the details had been submitted to the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) on Saturday.

In further updates, "We have submitted all these details to the CBI today. We have outlined three other important demands to the CBI in today's letter, as we intend to file a fresh petition in the High Court seeking immediate custodial interrogation of the accused and requesting that the investigation proceed under High Court supervision,” he added.

On top of that, Disha, who briefly worked with star Sushant Singh Rajput, died after falling from the 12th floor of a building in Malad at about 2:25 am on June 9, 2020. The Malwani police registered an accidental death report in connection with the incident and concluded that it was a suicide and that there was no evidence suggesting any foul play in it. A Special Investigation Team set up by the state government in December 2023 also found no foul play in Disha's death.
